title: Annual Vault Engineering Inspection

footer.manualLine: Visual Aid and Electrical System Maintenance Manual.

items.text: All semi-annual check items satisfactory (Checklist No. 14 completed)
Vault interior surfaces — no peeling paint, rust, or corrosion
All conduit, cable trays, and equipment housings — no corrosion or damage
All electrical connections torqued to specification
Transformer inspection: no leaks; oil level correct
All CCRs operating within tolerances (Table 4B-2 verified)
Safety board items all current and within certification dates
As-built drawings verified and updated if changes were made during the year
All test equipment calibration certificates are currently and filed in Technical Library
Annual Engineering Inspection Report prepared and submitted to Operations Manager and COO

validationRules: Every item marked NOSAT requires non-empty remarks before submission.
notes: Item codes C15-01.. are SYNTHETIC. The approved form lists items without identifiers; codes exist only so responses, incidents and audit records can reference a row, and must never be printed on the exported form.
Generated by scripts/vaes-extract.mjs from the approved base PDF. Re-run it rather than hand-editing; every coordinate is a measured glyph position.
Document control values are pre-printed constants on the approved form — not inputs, and never overlaid.
